In emerging markets, open finance is still nascent. Because this data is unstructured, credit and risk teams are forced into manual review. This slows decisioning, increases costs, and caps lending volume.

one_liner: Autonomous freight coordination
description: Cartage is the future of freight coordination. Transparent, tech-driven and eliminating the need for human coordinators.

one_liner: The AI mobile wallet that replaces Apple Pay
description:
Uno is the first third-party wallet granted access by Apple to become the default contactless wallet on iPhone. Uno is building a new payment rail, starting with a smarter wallet experience.

The wedge is credit card points optimization.

one_liner: Continual learning for AI agents
description:
Moda is the continual learning layer for agents. It surfaces patterns across agent hallucinations, laziness, context loss, and tool call failures, then attributes each issue to a specific layer of the agent harness: prompts, tools, workflows, retrieval, memory, and evals. It also discovers what users are actually trying to do and turns those findings into concrete counterfactuals the team can ship.

one_liner: The protocol for derivatives on blockchains
description:
EthosX is a decentralized finance platform creating end-to-end financial derivatives on blockchains. No centralized exchanges, clearinghouses, depositories, clearing banks, CSD participants etc. required.

We are starting with cryptocurrency options first, with the intention to move towards other crypto derivatives and traditional finance derivatives eventually.

one_liner: ARR Reporting and Forecasting for SaaS companies
description: Mantys helps SaaS companies calculate and forecast their ARR accurately in real time without using multiple spreadsheets. For example, NextBillion uses Mantys to pull data from HubSpot and Chargebee and create real-time views of their Contracted ARR, Billed ARR, Churn, and forecasted ARR

- On top of this, companies pay high markups to run CI on the hyperscalers.

one_liner: AI-native platform for corporate meetings and events
description:
Nowadays is the AI-native platform for corporate meetings and events. Our AI doesn't just assist planners – it does the work. It emails and calls venues, negotiates rates in 22 languages, parses 50-page hotel proposals into clean apples-to-apples comparisons, and surfaces unmanaged meeting spend across your entire org.

We work with companies ranging from ones planning one epic company kickoff a year to ones running thousands of meetings through the platform annually. Clients include Google, Airbnb, BlackRock, Anthropic, Pylon, and Mintlify.

name: Autumn
one_liner: Billing infrastructure for AI
description:
Autumn is open-source infrastructure over Stripe that allows AI startups to build their pricing plans quickly, and flexibly. We act as your app's DB and manage who's paying for what, track usage and manage customer feature access.

YC companies use us because we make it easy to handle common pricing models like usage-based, credits, subscriptions, rollovers and more in 3 functions and no webhooks.

one_liner: Float is the full-stack platform for Specialty Pharma
description: Float connects SuperNurses to home medication visits - making healthcare safer, easier, and cheaper by moving all the visits that don't need a hospital to the home

name: Tank Payments
one_liner: Modern financial infrastructure for the trucking industry.
description: Tank Payments is building modern financial infrastructure for the trucking industry. We offer payables automation software for logistics businesses that make hundreds of payments to trucking businesses every day. For trucking businesses, we provide a best-in-class banking platform, designed to meet the unique financial needs of the trucking sector.

name: Rindler
one_liner: The translation layer between AI agents and the web
description:
Rindler turns any website, including sites without APIs, into a deterministic API that AI agents can reliably use. It handles logins, 2FA, and bot detection, giving agents clean structured data and dependable actions instead of raw HTML, with robust maintenance when sites change.

Rindler is agent-agnostic and built on the open MCP standard, so it works with any agent.

For operators: get your team out of portals and back to the work that matters.

For agent builders: let your agents act on the real web quickly, cheaply, and reliably on every run.

name: Karoo
one_liner: AI native consumer lending platform for underserved Americans
description: US consumers within the risk appetite of prime lenders are served by the most competitive and efficient consumer lending marketplace globally. However, once you fall outside of this as a borrower, market efficiency breaks down and incumbents take advantage of low levels of competition to price gouge. We're fixing this.

name: SafetyKit
one_liner: AI agents for risk, compliance, and safety
description:
SafetyKit's AI agents do the dirty work for big tech and finance companies so humans don't have to.

Today companies rely on armies of low-paid outsourced humans to protect their platforms from fraud, harassment, and crime. It’s super important work, but the jobs are difficult and sometimes traumatizing, and it’s impossible to keep up. Our mission is to end this manual toil.

We learned this domain first-hand at Stripe and Airbnb, where first we built software for human reviewers, and then built models to replace them.

We’re a group of engineers from Stripe, Meta, Netflix, MIT, and Prin

name: GUILD
one_liner: Making aerospace parts faster and cheaper for defense
description:
GUILD is making aerospace parts faster and cheaper than today’s defense supply chain. We win defense contracts, automate manufacturing, and deliver to the government's door.

We’ve built an AI-native operating model for defense contracting: a company brain that connects requirements, pricing, supplier capability, compliance, manufacturing, finance, and delivery so each contract makes the next one faster and cheaper.

Infera handles the protocol logic, vendor-specific scripts, data, inventory, and institutional knowledge in one system. An AI-native compiler for the lab: one system from intent to execution.

description:
Jutsoo is a modern treasury management platform that helps finance teams work smarter by having efficient, reliable, real-time visibility and control over their financial data across their different banks and bank accounts.

We do this by unifying data from internal systems, integrating directly with banks for your money movements, and reconcile them automatically.

Money movements, reconciliations, cash forecasting, and identifying liquidity trends will be a breeze using us.

Our mission is to simplify finance for businesses in the Middle East and help them prosper. We integrate directly with RIS and EHR systems, creating true end-to-end automation rather than adding another software layer. Our HIPAA-compliant AI agents eliminate paperwork bottlenecks, reduce errors, and restore hours of clinical time - enabling care teams to focus on patients.
